description: Sprint V4.2A span-controlled planar-2R visual planning audit. Seventeen generated cases, ten frozen V3.6 tasks; implementation review only; not a population experiment and not a mechanism-performance claim. Identity-on-shared-Q is not a planner arm.
no_inference_statement: This audit does not support inferential statistics, stochastic repetition estimates, or ranking mechanisms by a hidden composite. Static print panels are authoritative; animations are supplementary. Failures remain in the report; tasks are not replaced after seeing outcomes.

lattice.note: Audit resolution only; not scientific evidence resolution. Connector quadrature uses 16 samples for tractable 32x32 integrated weights.

composite_diagnostic.name: J_alpha
composite_diagnostic.formula: J_alpha = alpha_U * L_U_hat + alpha_Q * L_Q_hat + alpha_X * L_X_hat

normalization.note: Hats are |L| / max(|L_fourbar|, |L_gearbox|, epsilon) within the trial for the same planner. Diagnostic only; not a ranking objective.
